name: Priam
source:
A kind of quirky woman who wears men clothing just because she likes to attract attention. (But it seems to do otherwise...)

Is stuck with her good-for-nothing twin brother Sabine; she doesn't think twice about debunking his show. She is fixated on the thought of what lies beyond death.

[Edited from [url=http://chegovia.itch.io/charlatans]itch.io[/url]]
